obligations.requirement: The orchestration plan preserves exact FrameState and ReferenceDrawList identity/content without mutating canonical scene state.
obligations.oracle: Build a distinguishable FrameState and nine-kind ReferenceDrawList, orchestrate them through the production boundary, and compare exact structural values before/after submission.
obligations.acceptance: Plan identity/content equals supplied inputs; no RuntimeScene or semantic mutation occurs.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused G3FrameOrchestration contract test and structural evidence JSON.

obligations.requirement: The backend seam consumes only the immutable renderer-neutral frame plan and exposes no Skia/platform types.
obligations.oracle: Compile and run a deterministic fake backend implementing the private interface; review public headers and dependency scan.
obligations.acceptance: Fake backend receives one immutable plan, returns a typed submission result, and forbidden backend/platform dependencies are absent.
obligations.evidence_required: Focused backend contract output and boundary scan.

obligations.requirement: Backend rejection is explicit and does not publish or mutate canonical state.
obligations.oracle: Inject deterministic fake-backend rejection and compare pre/post plan, RuntimeScene identity, and diagnostics.
obligations.acceptance: Rejected submission returns explicit failure with unchanged inputs and no partial frame publication.
obligations.evidence_required: Negative-path test transcript and result artifact.

obligations.requirement: G3-04 does not implement surface lifecycle, Skia backend, Tile/cache/scheduler optimization, or G3-05+ behavior.
obligations.oracle: Review-owned changed-path/dependency scan plus G3-01/G3-02/G3-03 and RF01/G2 regressions.
obligations.acceptance: Only authorized orchestration/backend-contract paths change and all predecessor tests pass.
obligations.evidence_required: Boundary scan, changed-path inventory, predecessor regression output, git diff --check.
